messages:
Talia Benson: :tada: Launch announcement: Perf Regression Canary (phase 1) is now live in prod.

What this is
- A low-footprint canary workload that continuously exercises a small set of inference patterns (prefill+decode, streaming + non-streaming) to catch runtime perf regressions early.
- We’re tracking p95 latency + tokens/sec stability per model/region (and key config slices like GPU SKU + runtime build).

Phase 1 scope (starting today)
- Region: us-east
- Models: 3 to start (see dashboard for the exact list) with a limited workload matrix
- Traffic is tagged `source=perf-canary` and runs in the new “canary-safe” request class (rate-limited + priority controls) so it shouldn’t contend with customer queues.

What alerts mean (please read)
- Alerts are *regression vs baseline* signals, not necessarily customer impact.
- Baseline is rolling (7d median) with deploy-window suppression. We’ll tune thresholds as we get more data.
- Initial routing: pages SRE for first-pass validation; if confirmed, Runtime gets looped in / auto-assigned.

Where to look
- Grafana dashboards (per-model + region, with deploy annotations): https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/perf-canary
- Runbook (triage + “what to do first” checklist): https://confluence.redwoodinference.internal/display/SRE/Runbook+-+Perf+Canary+Regression+Triage
- Design/overview: https://confluence.redwoodinference.internal/display/RT/Perf+Regression+Canary+Overview
- Linear initiative (milestones + owners): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2841

What we need from folks
- If you get paged, follow the runbook and please drop notes in the alert thread / incident channel on signal quality + any missing context in the payload.
- If you don’t have access to the dashboard namespace, file INT-3321 (or ping #help). Least-privilege applies.

We’ll do a quick review end of week to decide when to expand to eu-west + more models. Thanks to Runtime + SRE + Telemetry + Platform folks who got this over the line. :thumbsup:

Sean Gallagher: +1. Re paging hygiene: we’re starting conservative. If you see noisy alerts during warmup/deploy windows, please flag in #eng-sre so we can tweak suppression + minimum sample sizes. Goal is “actionable pages only”.

Felix Schneider: Dashboard details for phase 1: the landing page has quick filters for `model`, `region`, `gpu_sku`, `runtime_build`. If you’re debugging a spike, use the drill-down link in the top right (“canary slice explorer”). Also added a panel that overlays deploy annotations (runtime_version + git_sha).

Tomáš Novák: Runbook callout: Step 0 is always “confirm it’s real” (sample size + compare adjacent slices). Please don’t rollback on a single blip—look for persistence over the detector window + cross-check the `canary_safe_queue_depth` + node contention panels.

Rafael Mendes: PagerDuty note: perf canary alerts come from the new service “Perf Canary Regressions” and will also post to #eng-oncall via incident-bot with a structured payload (dashboard link + last deploy + runtime sha + gpu sku). If anything is missing in the Slack payload, reply in-thread and tag me.

Logan Wright: Telemetry side: please don’t add new labels to perf-canary metrics ad hoc. We’re already tight on cardinality. If you need another dimension for triage, open a ticket and tag Nadia/Caleb/Thomas B. Current allowed labels are in the metric spec doc.

Connor O'Brien: Release/train heads up: deploy annotations are wired to the runtime deploy pipeline. If you see an unannotated runtime change, it usually means a partial roll or a stuck emitter. Ping #release-engineering with the region + time window.

Incident Bot: (auto) Perf-canary phase 1 enabled: region=us-east, rollout=limited, source_tag=perf-canary. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/perf-canary Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.internal/display/SRE/Runbook+-+Perf+Canary+Regression+Triage

Talia Benson: Thanks all. Reminder: phase 1 = “tune + learn”. Expect some threshold adjustments this week. If we need to change what “page vs ticket” means, we’ll announce it here before flipping anything.
